comments.note: ITagsManager.GetEffectiveTagIds is synchronous and requires EnsureLoadedAsync to have completed. The interface remarks document this precondition, but there is no guard at the call site. Implementations should throw InvalidOperationException (or similar) if called before IsInitialized is true.

ITagsManager.WouldCreateParentCycle and WouldCreateGrantCycle have the same EnsureLoadedAsync precondition without a call-site guard. If invoked before initialization they could silently return false (no cycle) on an empty graph — a misleading result. Implementation should enforce initialization guard.

ITagsRepository.DeleteTagAsync documents a specific cascade order (tags_movies → tags_grants → child re-parent → delete row) in its XML summary. This cannot be verified at the interface level. A future integration test should confirm the cascade executes in the correct order with no orphaned FK rows when DapperTagsRepository is implemented.
